source.notes: Initial position on the green Prato stroke centreline nearest the official diagram P label, projected by distance into its registered ground patch with0.05m numerical inset. Glyph circles extend outside the stroke and are not physical seat coordinates. Not a surveyed seat or a visibility guarantee. No raycast-based location optimization; all ground remains freely selectable, and remembered user positions take precedence.

Organizer2026 map P stroke interpreted by ten manually identified turn controls and piecewise affine registration, with global affine continuation outside their hull.
